tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for the web app and responder dashboard.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, chat bubbles from NamMa, panels, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Gauge tracks, input fields, table header rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and quick-reply chips (3:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Source lines, timestamps, metadata. On surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Primary action fill, links, the station side of the product (river data). As text on surface, surface-raised and river-soft.

tokens.name: on-river
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a river fill (primary buttons).

tokens.name: river-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the user's own chat bubbles and selected rows.

tokens.name: home
tokens.usage: Household text and the house icon: saved-place labels, remembered facts. Same navy as ink; the house icon and the home-soft wave ground carry the meaning, not a hue.

tokens.name: home-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of household items (saved-place cards, the shelter row in alerts, memory chips). Saved-place cards add the home-wave pattern on top.

tokens.name: home-wave
tokens.usage: Wave lines drawn on home-soft for saved-place cards. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The water column inside a gauge (3:1 on surface-sunken). Never text.

tokens.name: bank
tokens.usage: The bank-top line drawn across a gauge. Same ink as text so it reads in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: line-green
tokens.usage: LINE's brand green, only for the LINE add-friend and LINE Login buttons. LINE's own white-on-green is 2.2:1 and fails WCAG; it is kept because LINE's brand rules require it. Use 18px bold labels and never use this green for anything else.

tokens.name: on-line-green
tokens.usage: Label and logo on a line-green button (LINE brand rule; see line-green).

tokens.name: tier-normal
tokens.usage: Risk tier ปกติ (normal) as a fill or mark. Quiet blue-grey on purpose: nothing to act on. Shape: filled circle.

tokens.name: on-tier-normal
tokens.usage: Text on a tier-normal fill.

tokens.name: tier-normal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a normal-tier card or row.

tokens.name: tier-normal-ink
tokens.usage: Normal-tier text on tier-normal-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tier-watch
tokens.usage: Risk tier เฝ้าระวัง (watch): rising and less than 0.5 m to bank. Shape: hollow ring. Only 1.9:1 on white, so a lone mark gets a 1px tier-watch-ink outline; a badge with text is fine.

tokens.name: on-tier-watch
tokens.usage: Text on a tier-watch fill. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: tier-watch-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a watch-tier card or row.

tokens.name: tier-watch-ink
tokens.usage: Watch-tier text on tier-watch-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tier-warning
tokens.usage: Risk tier เตือนภัย (warning): under 6 h to bank, or upstream over bank. Shape: triangle.

tokens.name: on-tier-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a tier-warning fill. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: tier-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a warning-tier card or row.

tokens.name: tier-warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning-tier text on tier-warning-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tier-danger
tokens.usage: Risk tier ล้นตลิ่ง (over bank). Shape: diamond. Also rescue urgency ด่วนมาก. Never used for decoration or for "delete".

tokens.name: on-tier-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a tier-danger fill.

tokens.name: tier-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a danger-tier card, alert or ticket row.

tokens.name: tier-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger-tier text on tier-danger-soft and surface-raised.

families.body: "IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped", "Noto Sans Thai Looped", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: น้ำจะถึงบ้านคุณไหม
styles.usage: Landing page question only. One per screen. On phones use 32px / 46px.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: น้ำในแม่น้ำน้อยล้นตลิ่งใกล้บ้านแม่
styles.usage: Screen titles and the headline of an alert card.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: สถานีใกล้บ้าน
styles.usage: Section headings inside a card or panel.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: ระดับน้ำต่ำกว่าตลิ่ง 0.42 ม. และกำลังสูงขึ้นค่ะ
styles.usage: Chat replies and alert body text. Large on purpose: many readers are older.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: ศูนย์พักพิงที่รับผู้ป่วยติดเตียง ห่าง 4 กม.
styles.usage: Default UI text, dashboard rows, form fields.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: ส่งขอความช่วยเหลือ
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, badges. Labels may wrap to two lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: ที่มา: กรมชลประทาน ผ่าน ThaiWater (สสน.) · 18:00 น. 16 ต.ค. 69
styles.usage: Source lines, times, the unofficial notice. Never smaller than 14px: Thai reads smaller than Latin at the same size.

styles.name: reading-lg
styles.sample: ต่ำกว่าตลิ่ง 0.42 ม.
styles.usage: The one headline reading on a station card, written in words (ต่ำกว่าตลิ่ง / ล้นตลิ่ง), never a bare minus sign. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: 4.90 ม.รทก. · สูงขึ้น 3 ซม./ชม.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Station codes and ticket ids only. Always second to the place name.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gap inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; padding of a badge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of buttons and table cells; gap between label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of a page; min tap target height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, gauge track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The chat composer only: the one object on a page that waits for the person.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Quick-reply chips only (they mirror LINE's quick replies).

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating panels and the map's station popover only. Cards sit flat with a line border.
